swete-ot-vol3: Henry Barclay Swete, ed., The Old Testament in Greek according to the Septuagint, vol. 3 (Cambridge, 3rd ed. 1912), the Odes after the Psalms: the Prayer of Manasses (Ode 8) from Codex Alexandrinus, with the readings of the Zurich Psalter (T) in the notes
swete-intro-psalters: H. B. Swete, An Introduction to the Old Testament in Greek (1900; rev. 1914), part 1, chapter 5, the entries for Codex Alexandrinus (A), the Verona Psalter (R) and the Zurich Psalter (T), read at biblehub.com
apostolic-constitutions-2: Constitutions of the Holy Apostles, book 2, section 22, trans. in Ante-Nicene Fathers, vol. 7, ed. A. Roberts, J. Donaldson and A. C. Coxe (1886), read at newadvent.org/fathers/07152.htm
je-prayer-manasseh: Crawford Howell Toy and J. F. McLaughlin, "Manasseh, Prayer of," The Jewish Encyclopedia (1901–1906), read at jewishencyclopedia.com
metzger-ej-manasseh: Bruce M. Metzger, "Manasseh, Prayer of," Encyclopaedia Judaica, with John Bowker's entry in The Concise Oxford Dictionary of World Religions, read at encyclopedia.com
dipippo-great-compline: Gregory DiPippo, "Byzantine Great Compline: The First Part" and "The Second Part," New Liturgical Movement (February 2022), newliturgicalmovement.org
these-truths-we-hold: These Truths We Hold: The Holy Orthodox Church, Her Life and Teachings, compiled by a monk of St. Tikhon's Monastery (St. Tikhon's Seminary Press, 1986), section on the books outside the Hebrew canon, as given on the site of St. Herman of Alaska Orthodox Church, Glen Mills, Pennsylvania (Orthodox Church in America)
asser-psalter: The Psalter of the Prophet and King David according to the Septuagint, after the use of the Orthodox Church, ed. Michael Asser (Shrewsbury, 2005), with the nine Odes and Psalm 151, read at liturgies.net
thirty-nine-articles-art6: The Thirty-Nine Articles of Religion (1571), Article VI, "Of the Sufficiency of the holy Scriptures for salvation," in the Church of England's text (churchofengland.org)
pajunen-4q381: Mika S. Pajunen, "The Prayer of Manasseh in 4Q381 and the Account of Manasseh in 2 Chronicles 33," in G. J. Brooke et al., eds., The Scrolls and Biblical Traditions, Studies on the Texts of the Desert of Judah 103 (Brill, 2012), 143–161
rahlfs-ccat-man: Alfred Rahlfs's Septuaginta (1935) text of the Prayer of Manasseh, as keyed in the CCAT files and republished in Eliran Wong's LXX-Rahlfs-1935 data set (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0); the text only, with no apparatus
charles-apocrypha-man: The introduction and Greek text of "The Prayer of Manasses" in The Apocrypha of the Old Testament, ed. R. H. Charles, vol. 1 (Logos reprint, 2004), pp. 612–624, as transcribed at myplace.frontier.com/~maripaul/Manassah.htm
